 Woodside. . . it’s a place for family fun, great food, backyard games, gift shop and the best live local music.Located in the heart of Gulf State Park on State Park Road.Open daily for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Pet-friendly outdoor seating. Food, beer and wine available for carry out. 
 
 
 
 CALL 251-923-3100 TO PLACE YOUR ORDER 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 View Menu
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 HOURS 
 
 
 
 Open Daily 8 am - 8 pm Breakfast: 8 am - 10:45 am  |  Lunch: 10:45 am - 4 pm  |  Dinner: 4 pm - 8 pm
